Is this supposed to work?

I tried
```
maven_jar(
    name = "jetty_server_sources",
    artifact = "org.eclipse.jetty:jetty-server:9.4.2.v20170220:jar:sources",
)
```

```
➜ bazel build "@jetty_server_sources//jar"
ERROR: no such package '@jetty_server_sources//jar': Failed to fetch Maven dependency: Could not find artifact org.eclipse.jetty:jetty-server:9.4.2.v20170220:jar:sources in jetty_server_sources (https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/).
```

Is it necessary to load this `maven_dependency_plugin` ? Or should it work with the built-in `maven_jar`?

I am using `bazel release 0.5.2-homebrew`

What unclear in this commit message: https://bazel-review.googlesource.com/7213 and in the example given there?

```
WORKSPACE:

  load("//tools:maven_rules.bzl", "maven_jar",
     "maven_dependency_plugin")
  maven_dependency_plugin()
  maven_jar(
    name = "jetty_server_sources",
    artifact = "org.eclipse.jetty:jetty-server:9.3.11.v20160721:jar:sources",
    sha1 = "b23cac190808baed928260b2c9beca3b1ed232b4",
  )

BUILD:

  java_library(
    name = "jetty-server-sources",
    exports = ["@jetty_server_sources//jar"],
  )

  $ bazel build :jetty-server-sources
  [...]
  Target //:jetty-server-sources up-to-date:
  bazel-bin/libjetty-server-sources.jar
```

I wasn't aware that there are native and skylark java rules.

I got it working now when I properly loaded the skylark rules:

    load("@bazel_tools//tools/build_defs/repo:maven_rules.bzl", "maven_jar")

issue.body:
in the land of bazel current dep solutions tools do not support classifiers (yet).  Currently the only viable option is to add the jar to a project's repo, or download the jar separately via http.

We exclude the main value annotations jar from the transitive classpath and without the annotations jar we get missing class  compiler warnings from other annotation processors and tools. Another downside of attached artefacts is that sources can't be naturally associated with them.

body:
The native rules seem to be working but have the packaging, classifier, version order mixed up.
The following code snippet works

    native.maven_jar(
        name = "com_salesforce_servicelibs_reactor_grpc",
        artifact = "com.salesforce.servicelibs:reactor-grpc:jar:jdk8:0.8.2",
        repository = "http://central.maven.org/maven2/",
    )

Artifact should thus be of the form: `groupId:artifactId[:packaging][:classifier]:version`
